description: This file defines interfaces and constants for configuring MAP-E tunnels (Mapping of Address and Port with encapsulation). It includes function declarations for setting up MAP-E, calculating PSID and IPv4 suffix, and resetting parameters, conditioned on feature support. It also contains include directives for related modules and external dependencies.
external_methods: INT WanManager_CalculateMAPEPsid(CHAR *, INT, INT, INT, USHORT *, UINT *, UINT *)

methods.name: WanManager_MAPEConfiguration
methods.description: Configures MAP-E tunnel using DHCPv6 MAP-E parameters, returning success or failure status.

methods.name: WanManager_CalculateMAPEPsid
methods.description: Calculates the PSID and IPv4 suffix based on IPv6 prefix, prefix lengths, and EA bits.

methods.name: WanManager_MAPE_ResetSyscfgDefaults
methods.description: Resets MAP-E related system configuration parameters to their default values.
